metadata.description: Mods and skills for Claude Code, tuned to how we work.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: live agents panel with plan quota, tokens and time per subagent; one pixel Clawd costume per tier.

plugins.name: stage-bar
plugins.description: Mod: animated, colorful progress bar above the prompt that tracks the stages of the task Claude is working on.

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: Mod: macOS notification when a long task finishes or Claude is waiting for you.

plugins.name: where-line
plugins.description: Mod: status line with project, git branch, model and context fill.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Skills: apple-design, review-animations, break-ui, prototype (Emil Kowalski) and hallmark (Nutlope) for better-looking web UI.

plugins.name: po-skills
plugins.description: Skills: brainstorming (with YC forcing questions) and writing-plans (with decision briefs and ponytail debt tracking), plus jira-stories and release-notes.

plugins.name: eng-skills
plugins.description: Skills: investigate (root cause debugging, 3-strike rule), qa (exploratory verification with mandatory regression tests), ship (pre-flight checks, doc sync, PR), freeze and careful.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the simplest code that works, YAGNI, stdlib first. Tracks upstream.
